title: Roster model pricing
description: What one roster model's tokens cost, for estimating supervisor calls whose runtime reports no cost. Kept beside the roster entry, not in it: an entry is hashed by its bytes, so a price there would start a new configuration group.

id.description: The roster id this price belongs to.

cachedInputUsdPerMillionTokens.description: Required: supervisor prompts are mostly cached input, so a missing rate would badly overstate an estimate. State the input rate when the provider gives no discount.

source.description: Where the price was read: a provider's price page, a contract.
